title: Storytelling Invite
tagline: The experience starts before the event.
shortDescription: Turns the invitation into the first chapter of the story: a teaser, a personal role or code, and a first small task, so guests arrive curious, prepared, and already part of the experience.
longDescription: A story-led layer for invitations, registration pages, and pre-event emails. Instead of a plain information mail, guests receive a teaser that introduces the world of the event, a personal role, team, or code, and a first action to take, such as answering a question, choosing a character, or unlocking a clue. Every answer flows into the journey, so the experience on site picks up exactly where the invitation left off. Story, tone, sequence of messages, languages, and the connected first steps are configurable. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Curiosity Before Arrival
highlights.description: A teaser story makes guests look forward to the event and talk about it before it starts, which lifts sign-ups and attendance.

highlights.title: Arrive Already Prepared
highlights.description: Roles, teams, and registration details are sorted before the event, so check-in is quick and the experience starts the moment guests walk in.

highlights.title: The Invitation Is Part of the Story
highlights.description: What guests choose or answer in the invitation reappears on site, so the event feels made for them from the very first email.

highlights.title: Build the Suspense
highlights.description: Add a countdown with a new clue each day, a secret code revealed only at the entrance, a team draw that guests can share, or a video message from the host.

highlights.title: Invitations That Tell a Story
highlights.description: Send agents on a mission for a product launch, invite employees to a time-travel company anniversary, open a museum night with a mystery to solve, or welcome conference guests with their own expedition role.

highlights.title: Know Who's Coming
highlights.description: Add a data layer that tracks opens, sign-ups, answers, and first actions, so the client sees interest and preferences before the event even begins.

highlights.title: The First Step of the Journey
highlights.description: Pair with Visitor Identificator to issue each guest's personal code, with Personality Quiz to assign roles before arrival, with Trail / Scavenger Hunt to start the first clue, or with Journey Manager to carry everything into the event.
